dataList.desc:
- A railway of purple light. It was labeled 'Line 5'.
- Just like in our last railway, chains of battles continued through consecutive stations, and we even faced off against more Peccatulum Invidiae. Some of them seemed to be reflecting relatively new possibilities as well... I wonder how they work?
- This railway began with two sections, met in the middle, and converged into one. It was pretty annoying to be locked out of Identity Cards I had already used in the second Section.
- Between each section was this odd... thing that empowered the Sinners. We had to carefully choose which of them to select, as it seemed to affect not only the Sinners, but our enemies as well.
- 紫色的轨道。上面写着5号线。
- 和以前的线路一样，战斗在数个站点中连续进行，同样需要与嫉妒罪种战斗。遇到的嫉妒罪种，还反映出最近才打捞到的可能性……这到底是什么原理呢？
- 轨道是分开的两个区段在中途合二为一的结构。因为在一个区段中使用的人格卡，不能在另一个区段再使用，所以有点麻烦。
- 区段之间有着某种能赋予罪人力量的奇怪存在。然而，它不仅会影响罪人，也会影响敌人，所以必须谨慎选择。

- Apparently, Associations in different cardinal regions—West, East, South, and North—each have different uniforms. It also seemed that Association Fixers working in the same region as their headquarters were considered to be stronger or higher-ranking than Association Fixers in other regions. And, sometimes, transfers between regions happened as a form of promotion as well.
- On the other end of the spectrum lies the largest Syndicates, the Fingers. Unlike the Associations, however, their outfits didn't vary much by region. They'd sometimes wear different outfits, but it's moreso due to the fact that they don't have a strict uniform code.
- 根据西部、东部、南部、北部的区分，协会的服饰似乎会有所不同。根据协会的不同，特定的区域会被视为本部，更强的收尾人会被分配到那里，同时也会有以晋升之名在区域间调动的情况。
- 与之相对，作为庞大帮派的手指的情况……与协会相比，不同区域的服装似乎没有太大差别。虽然也会有服饰不同的情况，但我认为那可能是他们并没有规定的制服，而是随喜好穿着的缘故。

- When declaring duels, the eastern Branch of the Cinq Association, instead of doing so by tossing their glove, do so by announcing their affiliation and name. - The biggest difference has to be their dress code and weaponry. Unlike the pretty iconic capes and large hats worn by the western Fixers, the eastern branch of the Cinq association wears a deft-looking outfit that blends in better with the general outfits of the eastern region. Also... unlike the other Cinq Fixers or Identities we've met thus far, the Sinner with the eastern Cinq Association's Identity primarily used hand-to-hand combat as their primary means of fighting. - They wear this bracelet... or bangle called 'Virescent Pyrojade' on their wrist. Looks like these can be used to melt whatever the user touches by applying high heat. - Apparently, the green flame of the Virescent Pyrojades has the power to burn only the object that the user wants it to. ... Honestly? That sounds like a Singularity-tier tech to me. - 据说，东部Cinq协会不以投掷手套，而是通过表明自身所属与姓名来申请决斗。 - 其最大的区别在于服装和武器。与西部那身令人印象深刻的蓝色披风和宽大帽子不同，制服似乎换成了便于灵活行动的东部风格服装……虽然至今见过的Cinq协会收尾人和人格都使用刺剑，但持有Cinq协会东部人格的罪人似乎是将格斗术作为主要作战方式。 - 其手腕上佩戴着名为翠炎玉器的手镯。利用它，似乎可以用高温熔化任何以手触及之物。 - 翠炎玉器的绿色火焰似乎可以只灼烧使用者指定的目标。这样的话，翠炎玉器不也是种奇点技术吗？

- This must be referring to the five particularly significant Syndicates of the Backstreets.
- It's been said that they're so powerful and influential that not even Wings or Associations can easily pick a fight with them. Rodya and Heathcliff told me that people in the Backstreets have to learn and abide by their rules if they want to survive.
- Weirdly enough, Ryōshū seems to know a lot about them. I was given a warning about Ryōshū's 'background' when I first boarded the bus... maybe that's got something to do with it.
- 是指后巷的各种帮派中，尤为庞大的5个帮派。
- 据说其势力十分强大，就连翼或是协会都无法轻易对其出手。罗佳和希斯克利夫告诉过我，要想在后巷生存，就必须了解并遵守他们的规则。
- 良秀对他们的情况异常了解。初登上巴士时，我就收到过关于良秀其背景的警告……说不定其中有什么关系。

- The Ring, one of the five Fingers, values art and knowledge.
- They keep popping up in discussions regarding the Corridor.
- I haven't had the chance to meet anyone from the Ring, but we ran into some people who used to be a part of it. They sure seemed to like art.
- And when I say 'art', I mean the extremely gruesome kind. From what I could gather from the Identities and what Ryōshū told me, their art often consists of sculptures stitched together from amputated body parts... paintings made of blood... things like that.
- They seem to be internally divided into various 'factions'. I picked up names like 'pointillists' or 'fauvists' among them—maybe they're divided along the lines of artistic philosophy.
- 重视艺术与知识的手指。
- 当谈及走廊时总会被提及的帮派。
- 虽然我没有亲眼见过环指，但我们在呼啸山庄见到了曾隶属于环指之人。给人的印象是其确实非常喜爱艺术。
- 综合通过人格获取的信息和良秀的说明来看，他们所谓的艺术，似乎远非一般的残忍行为所能相提并论。像是切断人体再重新接上……或是用血来绘画……
- 其内部似乎派系林立。由于对艺术的见解不同，他们因而分成了不同的派系。点彩派、野兽派……我已经听说过有这样的派系名称。

- Hongyuan Bioengineering Group. Their Nest is located in District 8.
- It's all stuffed into one big... Actually, the word 'big' does a disservice to the sheer magnitude of the megastructure that comprises the entirety of H Corp.'s District. District 8 as a whole is called 'Hongyuan'.
- Their Singularity is the creation of the 'Bolus', a type of medicine. I've been told that these things can be used not only to heal wounds but also for body modification procedures. But something about the way these medicines change your body creeps me out.
- Those who took these Boluses or used them in procedures would gain body parts of specific creatures—or have parts of their own bodies replaced with them.
- In District 8, depending on the amount of your net worth, the size of the room allotted to you could either grow or shrink, and the buildings themselves shift around to reflect that. So it's 'space' here, huh? Using time in T Corp. to measure one's wealth was weird enough.
- 鸿园生命工程集团。其巢位于8区。
- 巨大……不，巨大这个词都无法形容这压倒性的整个庞大建筑物，其整体似乎就是H公司的区域。整个8区都被称为“鸿园”。
- 持有制作被称为“丸”的药物的奇点，据说其不仅能用于常规治疗，还能用于人体改造手术。药物渗入身体并导致身体变形……总觉得不安。
- 服用丸或接受手术的人，身体的某处大多会长出特定生物的特征性部分，或是部位直接被后者替代。
- 据说房间的面积会根据持有的财产定期变化，建筑本身也会移动。在T公司，财产决定了生存的时间，而此处则是空间啊……

- They're something of a private army for various forces of Hongyuan.
- The only branch we've met so far is the Mao branch, but there are other Heishou Packs with characteristics of different animals.
- Jia Xichun told me that they wield the powers of twelve animals in a list called the 'Twelve Earthly Branches', something that most likely carries some sort of ritualistic meaning.
- I wonder if their allegiance could be traded? Conversations with the Identities revealed that they often change their masters—or, according to the Heishou, their 'lords'.
- Given that R Corp. also has 'Packs' themed after animals, I could draw some similarities between the Heishou and them.
- 似乎是鸿园势力所驱使的特殊武装团体。
- 我们遇到的只有卯，但据说也存在拥有其他动物特征的黑兽。
- 据贾惜春所说，他们能够运用被称为十二支的12种动物的特征，并且其中可能含有咒术层面的含义。
- 黑兽的所有权是可以交易的吗？通过与人格们的对话得知，其似乎频繁更换主公。
- 或许是因为R公司同样是由以动物为主题的部队组成的，我总觉得两者有些相似。

- As one of the five Fingers, they prioritize loyalty.
- We first encountered them during our journey in U Corp.'s Great Lake. They refer to each other using sibling terms like 'Big Brother', 'Big Sister', 'Little Brother', and so on and so forth, and I could really feel that they had this familial bond.
- They carry these books called the 'Book of Vengeance', in which they write down their grudges and go after anyone who's had the misfortune of getting written up... Speaking of which, just how long is that guy going to chase us for? I'm starting to get worried that I might one day find him barging into Mephistopheles.
- Recalling the events at J Corp., I think Rodya also suffered from her encounter with the Middle. Did their 'grudge' regarding Rodya get resolved? It's still kind of a sensitive subject, so I couldn't really bring it up to her just yet. I'm gathering more and more questions to ask Rodya as the days go by.
- 重视忠义的手指。
- 最初在U公司的大湖与他们遭遇。他们之间以大哥、大姐、弟妹等称呼彼此相称，氛围也如同真正的家人一般。
- 他们携带着名为复仇账簿的物品，据说他们会在上面记录仇怨的对象并不停追踪……但他们究竟打算追到什么程度？一想到这样下去他们说不定会一路追到梅菲斯托费勒斯内部，我就感到害怕。
- 回想起J公司的事，罗佳过去似乎和中指有过不愉快的纠葛。罗佳的仇怨是否已被清算？因为是敏感的话题，所以我至今还未能问出口。感觉想问罗佳的事情日渐增多了。

- They're... people, maybe? Anyways, they appear during the Night in the Backstreets.
- Aboard the bus, I just saw them as a vague crowd that moved past us, but... when we faced them in person outside the bus, they were truly unrelenting and numerous.
- As they sweep the streets, they melt down everything that needs to be cleansed—dead bodies in the Backstreets, unauthorized constructions, things like that. I do think it's somewhat necessary, but... I was at a loss for words when I learned that they melted down the random, unlucky people who got caught outside during the Night in the Backstreets, too.
- They can even melt down and eat their own and heal from it, which gave us quite the trouble. Really, really hoping that we won't have to fight them again.
- 后巷深宵出现的来历不明之人？
- 从巴士内观察时，只觉得有东西匆匆经过……但当我们在外面遇到清道夫时，才发现他们异常凶猛且密集。
- 从路上被遗弃的尸体到未经许可的建筑物，据说他们会将后巷中任何需要清扫的东西尽数溶解，并将其变成燃料。虽说是必要的工作……但是听到他们连好端端路过的行人也要溶解之后，我便哑口无言了。
- 他们连倒下的同伴都能溶解并吞噬，进而每次都能得到恢复，这对我们造成了极大的困扰。但愿今后……不要再与他们战斗了。

- Every 3:13 in the morning, the Sweepers emerge for eighty minutes to clean up the Backstreets of the City. 
- Starting from the borders of each Nest, they simultaneously emerge from the ground, march through the Backstreets, and sweep everything in their path away. Their march consists of three waves with about ten minutes of reprieve in between. I don't want to imagine what could've happened if we didn't even have that.
- Lots of things are banned when the Night in the Backstreets begins. We can't take videos or audio, or break into or destroy someone else's domicile...
- That reminds me—Faust told me that the Head wields the Sweepers. I can't even begin to imagine how they even cooperate with each other. Maybe it's got something to do with Taboos? Who knows. I certainly don't.
- 每天凌晨3点13分。这是清道夫清扫都市后巷的80分钟时间。
- 清道夫从各个巢的边界开始，自地下同时现身，沿着后巷推进并将所有东西一扫而空。其行进共计3波，每波之间有约10分钟的休息时间。如果没有休息时间的话……简直难以想象。
- 据说后巷深宵期间有许多被禁止之事。据罪人们所说，不能录像或录音、也不允许擅自侵入或破坏他人的居住区域……
- 说起来，浮士德曾提及清道夫是为首脑工作的。我完全无法想象他们是如何达成合作关系的。这是否与禁忌有关？目前还不太清楚。
